bandReport.notes: 36 questions, Q1-36 contiguous, no gaps. p00 is the instructions cover (T.B.C. XVWS-D-GNL, Test Booklet Series A, 120 items) and was NOT transcribed. Layout is a clean two-column grid with a vertical rule; each printed page carries exactly 6-7 items, left column then right column, and NO question straddles a page break anywhere in this band: p01 Q1-3 | Q4-7, p02 Q8-10 | Q11-13, p03 Q14-17 | Q18-20, p04 Q21-24 | Q25-28, p05 Q29-32 | Q33-36. Q1 (first item of p01) starts cleanly at the top of the left column and Q36 (last item of p05) ends cleanly above the footer, so nothing spills into or out of the band. No option block splits across the column break on any page. NOTHING belonging to a neighbouring band is visible: p01 begins at Q1 and p05's right column terminates at Q36 with white space below, so B2 must open at Q37 on p06. No figures, diagrams, graphs or circuits anywhere in this band. No Match List questions in this band. Code-option order was individually verified at 5-8x on both statement-code items: Q18 prints the all-statements row '1, 2 and 3' at (a) (NOT the more usual (d)) and Q35 prints '1, 2 and 3 only' at (a) — both are flagged on their rows. Scan is clean and fully legible; the only page defects are heavy black scanner margins on the right/bottom edges of every page, which do not touch text.
